items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is a gentler way to add the morning wash you asked for alongside your nightly tretinoin.
A daily mineral SPF 50 goes with tretinoin and keeps skin protected in the sun.
A simple barrier moisturizer adds comfort, since the scan shows a lower moisture score and both products can feel drying.

response.routine_note: Use the wash in the morning, then moisturizer and sunscreen, and keep your prescribed tretinoin for night so the two are not layered together. Start the wash a few mornings a week and check with your dermatologist if skin feels dry or irritated.
